# Code Core - High-Load iGaming & Crypto Casino Engine

> Open-source high-load architecture template designed for custom crypto casino and Web3 betting platform deployments. Clean architecture without IonCube encodings, designed for high-load systems and independent gateway integration.

## Core Overview
- Platform: Goldsvet modernized high-load engine framework.
- Architecture: Decentralized, modular, optimized for dedicated VPS/VDS (Hetzner, Contabo).
- Payments: Local blockchain gateway integration supporting USDT, TON, TRON (0% intermediary fees).
- Native Games: 12 built-in instant games (Crash, Plinko, Mines, Blackjack) requiring no external API traffic fees.
- Sportsbook: Full-scale sports betting module with customizable odds and admin analytics.
- Provider API: Standardized API gateway routing for Tier-1 slot providers and aggregators.
